newsitem.title: UK: UK government finds more money for rough sleepers.
newsitem.headline: UK government finds more money for rough sleepers.

text.p: The British government on Thursday announced a 27 million stg programme to help people sleeping rough in London find homes and to extend its "Rough Sleepers Initiative" to other towns around the country.

Working with the voluntary sector and charities, the government provides money under the initiative for outreach and resettlement work. The new money includes two million stg specifically for people with mental health problems.
The government claims the initiative has reduced the number of people sleeping rough on any one night in central London to less than 300 from over 1,000 in 1990 when the scheme began.
